meta.generator: Generator assumptions (NOT evidence about real runners): each runner has an invented 10 km time and a personal distance exponent; easy runs are 1.15-1.35 x race pace, tempo 1.05-1.10, races 0.99-1.01; ordinary runs carry 0-3 % stopped time; ultras carry aid-station stops.

methods.name: A: current production method (live; mmr-envelope-v2, labels are context only)

scales: Speed: 3000 × ln(7200 / T10) / ln(7200 / 1560); 10 km-equivalent (Riegel k 1.06) 2:00:00 = 0, 26:00 = 3000 (the app's fixed mapping).

Endurance (demonstrated distance completion, not estimated capacity): 3000 × ln(credited km) / ln(250); 1 km = 0, 250 km = 3000 (synthetic anchors). Credited km = distance × continuity (1 up to 5 % stopped, then falling 1:1, floor 0.5; missing moving time = 0.5) × running pace (1 to 0 across the walking anchor 10:00/km × (km / 10)^0.10 ± 10 %, moving pace).
Distance categories (C): 3000 × ln(v / 5 km/h) / ln(v_top(d) / 5 km/h) with synthetic near-elite anchor speeds per distance (not population standards).
Combined (B, D): speed weight × S + (1 − speed weight) × E. The weights are product choices, not validated.
